scope: Isolated warm-context GPU codec compression; host-memory input to host-memory compressed payload, no TAR/container/checksum/disk I/O
verification: Every batch in warmup and each timed repetition is GPU-decoded and compared bytewise outside the compression timer; LZ4 additionally uses an independent scalar CPU block decoder
timing_notes: Per-repeat compression wall time sums per-batch intervals; GPU verification is interleaved outside those intervals
Wall intervals include host staging, H2D input/tables, compression/status initialization, statuses/sizes D2H, actual compressed payload D2H, and host packing copy
compression_stage_ms is a CUDA event span including launch/queue/host gaps, not isolated kernel time
Context allocation includes benchmark-only GPU decode buffers; CUDA process initialize time is one shared first initialization, repeated as metadata on each row
No cold machine, power, thermal or memory peak controls; sequential fixed configuration order, three repeated measurements
LZ4/GDeflate counts raw block payloads, without required archive/container/index metadata; Zstd includes its native frame headers but no added content checksums
